name: Jumpnfinance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Jumpnfinance project Rugpull, involving an amount of about 1.15 million US dollars. The attacker first calls the 0x6b1d9018() function of the 0xe156 contract to extract the user assets in the contract and store them at the attacker's address (0xd3de02b1af100217a4bc9b45d70ff2a5c1816982).
